resources.string:
This privacy policy describes how Limb Motion Recovery App collects, uses, and protects your personal information.

We collect the following types of information:
• Personal information (name, email, phone number)
• Health and recovery data (exercise records, progress measurements)
• Device information (FCM token for push notifications)

Your data is stored securely and used only to provide and improve our services. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

For the full privacy policy, please visit our website.
